{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.31","title":"radio.py: live apply_all None pop is not sticky; next poll re-stashes","description":"## Problem

9098.20 closed on popping `_delayed_rx[(rx, tx)]` when live `apply_all` returns None, and on skipping `GilbertElliottRule` at re-inject so a live drop cannot be rolled again at expire.

The pop is not sticky. The same function immediately re-creates the stash on a later poll if `apply_all` returns a delayed candidate:

```python
if result is None:
    delayed_map.pop((node_id, candidate.transmission.id), None)
    continue
filtered_candidates.append(result)
if result.added_latency_us > 0:
    key = (node_id, result.transmission.id)
    if key not in delayed_map:          # true after the pop
        expire_us = result.transmission.end_time_us + result.added_latency_us
        delayed_map[key] = _DelayedRx(candidate=candidate, ...)
        self._event_queue.push(DelayedRxReadyEvent(expire_us, node_id))
```

`GilbertElliottRule.apply` is still invoked on every live poll (only re-inject skips it). Metrics docstring: the sim polls `get_rx_result` on a ~1 ms interval while a node waits. HIL (`renode_server._simulation_driver`) calls `deliver_pending_packets` every 1 ms. Callback RX stays in `RX_WAIT` while the LatencyRule filter holds the frame, so those polls keep running during airtime.

Timeline with LatencyRule + GilbertElliottRule:

1. TX start `_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`: GE may drop (no stash) or succeed (stash).
2. Poll N during airtime: live `apply_all` None → pop. `test_live_drop_pops_stash_no_resurrect` stops here.
3. Poll N+1 (next 1 ms): live `apply_all` succeeds (new GE draw), `key not in delayed_map` → stash + new `DelayedRxReadyEvent`.
4. Expire: medium TX is gone, `_reinject_delayed_candidates` skips GE, delivers the original candidate.

9098.20's fail-closed live drop is undone by the next poll. `test_live_drop_pops_stash_no_resurrect` only drops on `calls == 2` and never polls again before expire. `test_gilbert_elliott_live_drop_does_not_resurrect` polls once at t=1000 then jumps to expire.

This is not 9098.20 (no pop at all / GE on re-inject). After that fix, pop is a one-shot and the live stash arm has no negative cache.

Not 514j (orphan `DelayedRxReadyEvent` after prune). Re-stash queues a second wake and a live candidate.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (`_get_rx_result_internal` live apply_all None pop + `if key not in delayed_map` stash; `_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`)
- python/src/lichen/sim/metrics.py (documents ~1 ms RX poll)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (`test_live_drop_pops_stash_no_resurrect`, `test_gilbert_elliott_live_drop_does_not_resurrect` — single live poll)

## Why this is correctness

LatencyRule + GE is the chaos composition 9098.13/20 exist for. Production RX (HIL callback loop and polling `get_rx_result`) observes the same TX many times during airtime. A drop on any of those polls must keep the frame dead through expire, not only until the next millisecond.
